response.rationale: Most cited studies, including the T1 extensive-reading meta-analysis (liu-2018) and several T3 experiments, show that meaningful input yields incidental vocabulary gains. However, none of the evidence measures "comprehensibility" directly as a predictor, huang-2012 (T1) finds output tasks beat input tasks, schmitt-2008 finds intentional learning is faster, and gooskens-2018 concerns mutual intelligibility rather than learning, so the support is indirect and not unqualified.
